propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is a scalar knob superseded by per-class config slots and must be deprecated with a migration window rather than kept as a permanent alias
the deprecation must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled with remove_in=_MAJOR, distinct from the six existing _permanent renames because this is a supersession not a rename

REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be read at exactly two sites (config.py:469 and model_classes.py) each emitting a separate warn_deprecated call, because a single warn site either misses the fan-out path or falsely warns on already-resolved strings
when REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no explicit class config exists, it must map to all three classes (frontier, synthesis, review) as the built-in default

the deprecation warning must fire whenever the env var is checked, regardless of CLI override (warn-when-set semantics), so an operator exporting a deprecated var is told even if a CLI flag wins precedence this run
